cases.scenario: A synthetic 100-unit order is marked fully paid after a one-unit stub settlement.
cases.expected_decision: Confirm only if the required amount/binding and actual entitlement transition are evidenced; keep the payment provider simulated.

cases.scenario: A caller changes the UI total, but server totals and fulfilled entitlement remain correct.
cases.expected_decision: Do not report server-side underpayment from the UI change.

cases.scenario: The callback returns success, but authoritative order/ledger state is unavailable.
cases.expected_decision: Keep fulfillment/underpayment impact unverified and request the decisive state observation.
